candidates.name: Aganskaya-Vertikos Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Gazprom plans >400 km of new gas pipeline Aganskaya CS to Vertikos CS by 2029 to raise capacity of the Nizhnevartovsk GPP-Parabel-Kuzbass system; Tomsk deputy governor cites gas deficit. Diameter/capacity not stated.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not on roster by name. Could be treated as a looping/new line of P2350/P7615 (Nizhnevartovsk-Parabel-Kuzbass I/II); consolidator to decide. Length ~400+ km (stated as 'over 400').

candidates.name: Cherepanovo-Suzun Interposelkovy Gas Pipeline

evidence.note: Construction began Oct 2024 on 112 km inter-settlement gas pipeline serving 9 settlements (Otvazhny, Barinovo, Yarki, Krutishka, Karaseevo, Shurygino, Shipunovsky, Shipunovo, Suzun) under the 2021-2025 regional program; ~40 km built, completion planned 2026.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Cherepanovo or Suzun; nearest Novosibirsk rows (P2283, P2458, P4110) are different corridors. Diameter unknown. Spur/regional-distribution class, 112 km >= 25 km.

candidates.name: Nazyvaevsk District Interposelkovy Gas Pipeline (Loris-Melikovo-Spassk-Kochkovatka)

evidence.note: 49.6 km inter-settlement pipeline in Nazyvaevsk district for 7 settlements; ~5 km built Apr 2021, completion Q4 2021 planned; part of Omsk 2021-2025 program (>250 km of branches, 7 GDS).

candidates.why_maybe_new: Borderline: roster P3982 (Tyukalinsk-Valuevskaya-Nalimovskaya-Nazyvaevsk, 98 km, construction) is the same program and may include this; consolidator to check. Likely operating by now.
